verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְדָרְיָ֛וֶשׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָמְלַ֔ךְ עַ֖ל מַלְכ֥וּת כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš ben- ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš miz·ze·ra‘ mā·ḏāy ’ă·šer hā·mə·laḵ ‘al mal·ḵūṯ kaś·dîm
verses.literal: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes a Mede by descent who was made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: NO ano primeiro de Dario, filho de Assuero, da linhagem dos medos, o qual foi constituído rei sobre o reino dos caldeus,

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת אַחַת֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ אֲנִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל בִּינֹ֖תִי בַּסְּפָרִ֑ים מִסְפַּ֣ר הַשָּׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יִרְמִיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא לְמַלֹּ֛אות לְחָרְב֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·mā·lə·ḵōw ’ă·nî dā·nî·yêl bî·nō·ṯî bas·sə·p̄ā·rîm mis·par haš·šā·nîm ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mi·yāh han·nā·ḇî lə·mal·lō·wṯ lə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: in the first year of his reign I Daniel understood from the sacred books - - according to the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years
verses.literalPt: No primeiro ano do seu reinado, eu, Daniel, entendi pelos livros que o número dos anos, de que falara o SENHOR ao profeta Jeremias, em que haviam de cumprir-se as desolações de Jerusalém, era de setenta anos.

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה אֶת־ פָּנַ֗י אֶל־ אֲדֹנָי֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ תְּפִלָּ֖ה וְתַחֲנוּנִ֑ים בְּצ֖וֹם וְשַׂ֥ק וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tə·nāh ’eṯ- pā·nay ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ḇaq·qêš tə·p̄il·lāh wə·ṯa·ḥă·nū·nîm bə·ṣō·wm wə·śaq wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: So I turned my attention - to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition with fasting sackcloth and ashes
verses.literalPt: E eu dirigi o meu rosto ao Senhor Deus, para o buscar com oração e súplicas, com jejum, e saco e cinza.

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְפַּֽלְלָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י וָאֶתְוַדֶּ֑ה וָאֹֽמְרָ֗ה אָנָּ֤א אֲדֹנָי֙ הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֖יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pal·lāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay wā·’eṯ·wad·deh wā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ān·nā ’ă·ḏō·nāy hā·’êl hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·han·nō·w·rā šō·mêr hab·bə·rîṯ wə·ha·ḥe·seḏ lə·’ō·hă·ḇāw ū·lə·šō·mə·rê miṣ·wō·ṯāw
verses.literal: And I prayed to the LORD my God and confessed . . . O Lord the great and awesome God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion to those who love Him and keep His commandments
verses.literalPt: E orei ao SENHOR meu Deus, e confessei, e disse: Ah! Senhor! Deus grande e tremendo, que guardas a aliança e a misericórdia para com os que te amam e guardam os teus mandamentos;

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ וְעָוִ֖ינוּ וְהִרְשַׁעְנוּ וּמָרָ֑דְנוּ וְס֥וֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖ךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṭā·nū wə·‘ā·wî·nū wə·hir·šaʿ·nū ū·mā·rā·ḏə·nū wə·sō·wr mim·miṣ·wō·ṯe·ḵā ū·mim·miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā
verses.literal: we have sinned and done wrong We have acted wickedly and rebelled We have turned away from Your commandments and ordinances
verses.literalPt: Pecamos, e cometemos iniqüidades, e procedemos impiamente, e fomos rebeldes, apartando-nos dos teus mandamentos e dos teus juízos;

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבְּרוּ֙ בְּשִׁמְךָ֔ אֶל־ מְלָכֵ֥ינוּ שָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·ma‘·nū ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ă·šer dib·bə·rū bə·šim·ḵā ’el- mə·lā·ḵê·nū śā·rê·nū wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū wə·’el kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: We have not listened to Your servants the prophets who spoke in Your name to our kings leaders fathers and all the people of the land
verses.literalPt: E não demos ouvidos aos teus servos, os profetas, que em teu nome falaram aos nossos reis, aos nossos príncipes, e a nossos pais, como também a todo o povo da terra.

verses.original: לְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָי֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה וְלָ֛נוּ בֹּ֥שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֖ים כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וּלְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּֽלְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים וְהָרְחֹקִ֗ים בְּכָל־ הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתָּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy haṣ·ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·lā·nū bō·šeṯ hap·pā·nîm kay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ū·lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ū·lə·ḵāl- yiś·rā·’êl haq·qə·rō·ḇîm wə·hā·rə·ḥō·qîm bə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tām šām bə·ma·‘ă·lām ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: To You O Lord belongs righteousness but this day we are covered with shame the men of Judah the people of Jerusalem and all Israel near and far in all the countries to which You have driven us . . . because of our unfaithfulness to You
verses.literalPt: A ti, ó Senhor, pertence a justiça, mas a nós a confusão de rosto, como hoje se vê; aos homens de Judá, e aos moradores de Jerusalém, e a todo o Israel, aos de perto e aos de longe, em todas as terras por onde os tens lançado, por causa das suas rebeliões que cometeram contra ti.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה לָ֚נוּ בֹּ֣שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֔ים לִמְלָכֵ֥ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lā·nū bō·šeṯ hap·pā·nîm lim·lā·ḵê·nū lə·śā·rê·nū wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: O LORD we are covered with shame our kings our leaders and our fathers because we have sinned against You
verses.literalPt: Ó Senhor, a nós pertence a confusão de rosto, aos nossos reis, aos nossos príncipes, e a nossos pais, porque pecamos contra ti.

verses.original: לַֽאדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הָרַחֲמִ֖ים וְהַסְּלִח֑וֹת כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְנוּ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḏō·nāy ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hā·ra·ḥă·mîm wə·has·sə·li·ḥō·wṯ kî mā·raḏ·nū bōw
verses.literal: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness even though we have rebelled against Him
verses.literalPt: Ao Senhor, nosso Deus, pertencem a misericórdia, e o perdão; pois nos rebelamos contra ele,

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּתֽוֹרֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·ma‘·nū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ṯō·w·rō·ṯāw ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lə·p̄ā·nê·nū bə·yaḏ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God to walk in His laws which He set before us through His servants the prophets
verses.literalPt: E não obedecemos à voz do SENHOR, nosso Deus, para andarmos nas suas leis, que nos deu por intermédio de seus servos, os profetas.

verses.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־ תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔ךָ וְס֕וֹר לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּקֹלֶ֑ךָ וַתִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜ינוּ הָאָלָ֣ה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּתוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- tō·w·rā·ṯe·ḵā wə·sō·wr lə·ḇil·tî šə·mō·w·a‘ bə·qō·le·ḵā wat·tit·taḵ ‘ā·lê·nū hā·’ā·lāh wə·haš·šə·ḇu·‘āh ’ă·šer kə·ṯū·ḇāh bə·ṯō·w·raṯ mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî ḥā·ṭā·nū lōw
verses.literal: All Israel has transgressed Your law and turned away refusing to obey Your voice so the oath and the curse written in the Law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us because we have sinned against You
verses.literalPt: Sim, todo o Israel transgrediu a tua lei, desviando-se para não obedecer à tua voz; por isso a maldição e o juramento, que estão escritos na lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, se derramaram sobre nós; porque pecamos contra ele.

verses.original: וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־ דְּבָרָיו אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗ינוּ וְעַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּנוּ לְהָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ’eṯ- də·ḇå̄·rå̄w ’ă·šer- dib·ber ‘ā·lê·nū wə·‘al šō·p̄ə·ṭê·nū ’ă·šer šə·p̄ā·ṭū·nū lə·hā·ḇî ‘ā·lê·nū rā·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·lāh ’ă·šer lō- ne·‘eś·ṯāh ta·ḥaṯ kāl- haš·šā·ma·yim ka·’ă·šer ne·‘eś·ṯāh bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: You have carried out the words spoken against us and against our rulers - by bringing upon us a great disaster For under all of heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E ele confirmou a sua palavra, que falou contra nós, e contra os nossos juízes que nos julgavam, trazendo sobre nós um grande mal; porquanto debaixo de todo o céu nunca se fez como se tem feito em Jerusalém.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְלֹֽא־ חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לָשׁוּב֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer kā·ṯūḇ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ mō·šeh ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ bā·’āh ‘ā·lê·nū wə·lō- ḥil·lî·nū ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lā·šūḇ mê·‘ă·wō·nê·nū ū·lə·haś·kîl ba·’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses all this disaster has come upon us yet we have not sought the favor . . . . . . of the LORD our God by turning from our iniquities and giving attention to Your truth
verses.literalPt: Como está escrito na lei de Moisés, todo este mal nos sobreveio; apesar disso, não suplicamos à face do SENHOR nosso Deus, para nos convertermos das nossas iniqüidades, e para nos aplicarmos à tua verdade.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ עַל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַיְבִיאֶ֖הָ עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ צַדִּ֞יק יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַל־ כָּל־ מַֽעֲשָׂיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·qōḏ Yah·weh ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh way·ḇî·’e·hā ‘ā·lê·nū kî- ṣad·dîq Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘al- kāl- ma·‘ă·śāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·lō šā·ma‘·nū bə·qō·lōw
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD has kept the calamity in store and brought it upon us For the LORD our God is righteous in all . . . He does yet we have not obeyed His voice
verses.literalPt: Por isso o SENHOR vigiou sobre o mal, e o trouxe sobre nós; porque justo é o SENHOR, nosso Deus, em todas as suas obras, que fez, pois não obedecemos à sua voz.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־ עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־ לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh wat·ta·‘aś- lə·ḵā šêm kay·yō·wm haz·zeh ḥā·ṭā·nū rā·šā·‘ə·nū
verses.literal: Now O Lord our God who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for Yourself a name renowned to this day we have sinned we have acted wickedly
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor, nosso Deus, que tiraste o teu povo da terra do Egito com mão poderosa, e ganhaste para ti nome, como hoje se vê; temos pecado, temos procedido impiamente.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכָל־ צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשָׁב־ נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הַר־ קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־ סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy kə·ḵāl- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯe·ḵā yā·šāḇ- nā ’ap·pə·ḵā wa·ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā mê·‘î·rə·ḵā yə·rū·šā·lim har- qāḏ·še·ḵā kî ḇa·ḥă·ṭā·’ê·nū ū·ḇa·‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū yə·rū·šā·lim wə·‘am·mə·ḵā lə·ḥer·pāh lə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: O Lord in keeping with all Your righteous acts I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem Your holy mountain for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us
verses.literalPt: Ó Senhor, segundo todas as tuas justiças, aparte-se a tua ira e o teu furor da tua cidade de Jerusalém, do teu santo monte; porque por causa dos nossos pecados, e por causa das iniqüidades de nossos pais, tornou-se Jerusalém e o teu povo um opróbrio para todos os que estão em redor de nós.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־ תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־ תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־ מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’el- tə·p̄il·laṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wə·’el- ta·ḥă·nū·nāw wə·hā·’êr pā·ne·ḵā ‘al- miq·dā·šə·ḵā haš·šā·mêm lə·ma·‘an ’ă·ḏō·nāy
verses.literal: So now our God . . . hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant For Your sake O Lord cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó Deus nosso, ouve a oração do teu servo, e as suas súplicas, e sobre o teu santuário assolado faze resplandecer o teu rosto, por amor do Senhor.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשֲׁמָע֒ פִּקְחָה עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י׀ לֹ֣א עַל־ צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־ רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭêh ’ĕ·lō·hay ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ū·šă·mā‘ piq·ḥå̄h ‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh šō·mə·mō·ṯê·nū wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer- niq·rā šim·ḵā ‘ā·le·hā kî lō ‘al- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯê·nū ’ă·naḥ·nū map·pî·lîm ta·ḥă·nū·nê·nū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî ‘al- ra·ḥă·me·ḵā hā·rab·bîm
verses.literal: Incline Your ear O my God and hear open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts but because of Your great compassion
verses.literalPt: Inclina, ó Deus meu, os teus ouvidos, e ouve; abre os teus olhos, e olha para a nossa desolação, e para a cidade que é chamada pelo teu nome, porque não lançamos as nossas súplicas perante a tua face fiados em nossas justiças, mas em tuas muitas misericórdias.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקֲשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־ תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעֲנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־ שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־ עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־ עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy šə·mā·‘āh ’ă·ḏō·nāy sə·lā·ḥāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ha·qă·šî·ḇāh wa·‘ă·śêh ’al- tə·’a·ḥar lə·ma·‘ăn·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hay kî- šim·ḵā niq·rā ‘al- ‘î·rə·ḵā wə·‘al- ‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: O Lord listen O Lord forgive O Lord hear and act For Your sake O my God do not delay because Your city . . . and Your people bear . . . Your name
verses.literalPt: Ó Senhor, ouve; ó Senhor, perdoa; ó Senhor, atende-nos e age sem tardar; por amor de ti mesmo, ó Deus meu; porque a tua cidade e o teu povo são chamados pelo teu nome.

verses.original: וְע֨וֹד אֲנִ֤י מְדַבֵּר֙ וּמִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וּמִתְוַדֶּה֙ חַטָּאתִ֔י וְחַטַּ֖את עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַפִּ֣יל תְּחִנָּתִ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔י עַ֖ל הַר־ קֹ֥דֶשׁ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr ū·miṯ·pal·lêl ū·miṯ·wad·deh ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî wə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl ū·map·pîl tə·ḥin·nā·ṯî lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay ‘al har- qō·ḏeš ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: While I was speaking praying confessing my sin and that of my people Israel and presenting my petition before the LORD my God concerning His holy mountain
verses.literalPt: Estando eu ainda falando e orando, e confessando o meu pecado, e o pecado do meu povo Israel, e lançando a minha súplica perante a face do SENHOR, meu Deus, pelo monte santo do meu Deus,

verses.original: וְע֛וֹד אֲנִ֥י מְדַבֵּ֖ר בַּתְּפִלָּ֑ה וְהָאִ֣ישׁ גַּבְרִיאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ רָאִ֨יתִי בֶחָז֤וֹן בַּתְּחִלָּה֙ מֻעָ֣ף בִּיעָ֔ף נֹגֵ֣עַ אֵלַ֔י כְּעֵ֖ת מִנְחַת־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr bat·tə·p̄il·lāh wə·hā·’îš gaḇ·rî·’êl ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî ḇe·ḥā·zō·wn bat·tə·ḥil·lāh mu·‘āp̄ bî·‘āp̄ nō·ḡê·a‘ ’ê·lay kə·‘êṯ min·ḥaṯ- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: while I was still praying . . . Gabriel the man I had seen in the earlier . . . vision came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice
verses.literalPt: Estando eu, digo, ainda falando na oração, o homem Gabriel, que eu tinha visto na minha visão ao princípio, veio, voando rapidamente, e tocou-me, à hora do sacrifício da tarde.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖בֶן וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמִּ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר דָּנִיֵּ֕אל עַתָּ֥ה יָצָ֖אתִי לְהַשְׂכִּילְךָ֥ בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇen way·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mî way·yō·mar dā·nî·yêl ‘at·tāh yā·ṣā·ṯî lə·haś·kî·lə·ḵā ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: He instructed me and spoke with me saying O Daniel I have come now to give you insight and understanding
verses.literalPt: Ele me instruiu, e falou comigo, dizendo: Daniel, agora saí para fazer-te entender o sentido.

verses.original: בִּתְחִלַּ֨ת תַּחֲנוּנֶ֜יךָ יָצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר וַאֲנִי֙ בָּ֣אתִי לְהַגִּ֔יד כִּ֥י חֲמוּד֖וֹת אָ֑תָּה וּבִין֙ בַּדָּבָ֔ר וְהָבֵ֖ן בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biṯ·ḥil·laṯ ta·ḥă·nū·ne·ḵā yā·ṣā ḏā·ḇār wa·’ă·nî bā·ṯî lə·hag·gîḏ kî ḥă·mū·ḏō·wṯ ’āt·tāh ū·ḇîn bad·dā·ḇār wə·hā·ḇên bam·mar·’eh
verses.literal: At the beginning of your petitions an answer went out and I have come to tell you for you are highly precious So consider the message and understand the vision
verses.literalPt: No princípio das tuas súplicas, saiu a ordem, e eu vim, para to declarar, porque és mui amado; considera, pois, a palavra, e entende a visão.

verses.original: שָׁבֻעִ֨ים שִׁבְעִ֜ים נֶחְתַּ֥ךְ עַֽל־ עַמְּךָ֣׀ וְעַל־ עִ֣יר קָדְשֶׁ֗ךָ לְכַלֵּ֨א הַפֶּ֜שַׁע וּלַחְתֹּם חַטָּאוֹת וּלְכַפֵּ֣ר עָוֺ֔ן וּלְהָבִ֖יא צֶ֣דֶק עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וְלַחְתֹּם֙ חָז֣וֹן וְנָבִ֔יא וְלִמְשֹׁ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ḇu·‘îm šiḇ·‘îm neḥ·taḵ ‘al- ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·‘al- ‘îr qāḏ·še·ḵā lə·ḵal·lê hap·pe·ša‘ ū·laḥ·tōm ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·ʾōṯ ū·lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·wōn ū·lə·hā·ḇî ṣe·ḏeq ‘ō·lā·mîm wə·laḥ·tōm ḥā·zō·wn wə·nā·ḇî wə·lim·šō·aḥ qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people . . . and your holy city to stop their transgression to put an end to sin to make atonement for iniquity to bring in everlasting righteousness to seal up vision and prophecy and to anoint the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: Setenta semanas estão determinadas sobre o teu povo, e sobre a tua santa cidade, para cessar a transgressão, e para dar fim aos pecados, e para expiar a iniqüidade, e trazer a justiça eterna, e selar a visão e a profecia, e para ungir o Santíssimo.

verses.original: וְתֵדַ֨ע וְתַשְׂכֵּ֜ל מִן־ מֹצָ֣א דָבָ֗ר לְהָשִׁיב֙ וְלִבְנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עַד־ מָשִׁ֣יחַ נָגִ֔יד שָׁבֻעִ֖ים שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְשָׁבֻעִ֞ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁנַ֗יִם תָּשׁוּב֙ וְנִבְנְתָה֙ רְח֣וֹב וְחָר֔וּץ וּבְצ֖וֹק הָעִתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯê·ḏa‘ wə·ṯaś·kêl min- mō·ṣā ḏā·ḇār lə·hā·šîḇ wə·liḇ·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ‘aḏ- mā·šî·aḥ nā·ḡîḏ šā·ḇu·‘îm šiḇ·‘āh wə·šā·ḇu·‘îm šiš·šîm ū·šə·na·yim tā·šūḇ wə·niḇ·nə·ṯāh rə·ḥō·wḇ wə·ḥā·rūṣ ū·ḇə·ṣō·wq hā·‘it·tîm
verses.literal: Know and understand this From the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Messiah the Prince there will be seven weeks and sixty-two . . . weeks It will be rebuilt . . . with streets and a trench but in times of distress
verses.literalPt: Sabe e entende: desde a saída da ordem para restaurar, e para edificar a Jerusalém, até ao Messias, o Príncipe, haverá sete semanas, e sessenta e duas semanas; as ruas e o muro se reedificarão, mas em tempos angustiosos.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֤י הַשָּׁבֻעִים֙ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁנַ֔יִם יִכָּרֵ֥ת מָשִׁ֖יחַ וְאֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ וְהָעִ֨יר וְהַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ יַ֠שְׁחִית עַ֣ם נָגִ֤יד הַבָּא֙ וְקִצּ֣וֹ בַשֶּׁ֔טֶף וְעַד֙ קֵ֣ץ מִלְחָמָ֔ה נֶחֱרֶ֖צֶת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê haš·šā·ḇu·‘îm šiš·šîm ū·šə·na·yim yik·kā·rêṯ mā·šî·aḥ wə·’ên lōw wə·hā·‘îr wə·haq·qō·ḏeš yaš·ḥîṯ ‘am nā·ḡîḏ hab·bā wə·qiṣ·ṣōw ḇaš·še·ṭep̄ wə·‘aḏ qêṣ mil·ḥā·māh ne·ḥĕ·re·ṣeṯ šō·mê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then after the sixty-two . . . weeks the Messiah will be cut off and will have nothing Then the people of the prince who is to come will destroy the city and the sanctuary The end will come like a flood and until the end there will be war desolations have been decreed
verses.literalPt: E depois das sessenta e duas semanas será cortado o Messias, mas não para si mesmo; e o povo do príncipe, que há de vir, destruirá a cidade e o santuário, e o seu fim será com uma inundação; e até ao fim haverá guerra; estão determinadas as assolações.

verses.original: וְהִגְבִּ֥יר בְּרִ֛ית לָרַבִּ֖ים שָׁב֣וּעַ אֶחָ֑ד וַחֲצִ֨י הַשָּׁב֜וּעַ יַשְׁבִּ֣ית׀ זֶ֣בַח וּמִנְחָ֗ה וְעַ֨ל כְּנַ֤ף שִׁקּוּצִים֙ מְשֹׁמֵ֔ם וְעַד־ כָּלָה֙ וְנֶ֣חֱרָצָ֔ה תִּתַּ֖ךְ עַל־ שֹׁמֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·bîr bə·rîṯ lā·rab·bîm šā·ḇū·a‘ ’e·ḥāḏ wa·ḥă·ṣî haš·šā·ḇū·a‘ yaš·bîṯ ze·ḇaḥ ū·min·ḥāh wə·‘al kə·nap̄ šiq·qū·ṣîm mə·šō·mêm wə·‘aḏ- kā·lāh wə·ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh tit·taḵ ‘al- šō·mêm
verses.literal: And he will confirm a covenant with many for one week but in the middle of the week he will put an end to sacrifice and offering And on the wing of the temple will come the abomination that causes desolation until the decreed destruction is poured out upon him
verses.literalPt: E ele firmará aliança com muitos por uma semana; e na metade da semana fará cessar o sacrifício e a oblação; e sobre a asa das abominações virá o assolador, e isso até à consumação; e o que está determinado será derramado sobre o assolador.
